title: Beyond the unit mix-up, the risk formulas are wrong: each partial sell is charged the full buy cost in the daily-loss sum, exposure subtracts sale proceeds instead of the cost sold (it goes negative on a profitable partial), buy gas is never recorded, and ETH and BNB amounts are added into one total against one cap

evidence.note: one row per sell joined to its buy: s.amount_out - b.amount_in - b.gas_cost - s.gas_cost; with two partial sells and a final sell the buy cost is subtracted three times
exposure = amount_in - SUM(partial_sell amount_out): proceeds, not the share of cost sold
buy rows write gasCost: null (also :1464, :782), so buy gas never enters any loss figure
no chain filter: BSC amounts (BNB) and ETH/Base/Arbitrum amounts (ETH) are summed into one number compared with MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE
join on token + chain + s.timestamp >= b.timestamp: a second buy of the same token joins every earlier sell (same-token rebuys, AUD-EXIT-018)

sibling_sites_checked: getPnLQuery (:351-384) and getPnLChartDataQuery (:463-485) use the same join; api/routes/risk.ts:66 pro-rates the buy cost per event for its chart (API slice), so the dashboard and the breaker compute loss differently. These defects remain after AUD-DB-002 is fixed, so they are a separate entry.
severity_rationale: S2: the double charge makes the breaker trip early (fail-closed direction); the proceeds-based exposure and the cross-currency total let the exposure cap be exceeded by bounded amounts (fail-open direction); buy gas is a small understatement. Bounded effects, so below the S1 of AUD-DB-002.
recommendation: Define realized loss per position (proceeds minus cost of the part sold minus all gas), exposure as remaining cost basis, and keep totals per currency (or convert explicitly). Card DB-01. Phase 24.
